From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Short 'Before/After' metrics for renewal booklet

Hi Lena —

Quick ask as we prepare HorizonPay's renewal package: the renewals and Product teams want a compact one-pager showing the key before/after metrics that resulted from the pilot we ran with you. Would you be able to share the short, high-level numbers we can publish (public-facing, used in a one-page case study)? Helpful format: a simple before -> after pair for 3 metrics, and a one-sentence quote we can attribute to HorizonPay.

Suggested metrics (pick whichever you have):
- Avg inference latency (ms) before / after
- Cost per 1M tokens (approx) before / after
- Error rate / failed requests per 1000 before / after (or % improvement)

If you're comfortable, I attached a one-click consent stub that your legal team can sign quickly (consent_short_form.pdf). If you prefer we can anonymize company name, but HorizonPay attribution would be ideal.

Timing: we're aiming to include this in the renewal packet by next Tuesday (Apr 6). Short reply with numbers + quote is perfect.

Thanks so much — appreciate it.

— Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
[Attachment: consent_short_form.pdf (PDF)]

From: Lena Ortiz <lena@horizonpay.com>

Cc: HorizonPay Legal <legal@horizonpay.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short 'Before/After' metrics for renewal booklet

Hi Sofia —

Happy to help. We've reviewed internally and can share the following high-level numbers for use in a public one-pager. HorizonPay is comfortable with the attribution below; legal is CC'd and has seen the consent form.

Before -> After (pilot: Q3 2026 -> Q4 2026)
- Avg inference latency: 420ms -> 95ms
- Approx cost per 1M tokens (inference only): $320 -> $84
- Failed request rate (per 1k): 7.8 -> 1.1 (≈86% reduction)

One-sentence quote you may use: "Redwood's runtime cut latency and costs dramatically for us — the result was faster customer workflows and a clear ROI for our fraud-detection pipeline." — Lena Ortiz, Head of Engineering, HorizonPay

I attached the spreadsheet we use internally with the before/after calc. Legal, please flag if anything needs to change on the consent.

— Lena
Lena Ortiz
Head of Engineering | HorizonPay
lena@horizonpay.com
[Attachment: HorizonPay_before_after_metrics.xlsx (XLSX)]

Timeline: I'd like the one-pager in draft by EOD Tuesday (Apr 6) so we can fold into the renewal deck. I'll follow up with legal if we need a signed PDF.

Thanks — 
Sofia
